comparison.objective: Test sanitizer with a strip and conditionally add a tablet; the candidate mechanically calibrates and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Thin-strip grasping, timed dipping, visual measurement, and conditional dosing versus coaxial tool seating and countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: A valid test precedes correct final concentration and strip disposal; candidate requires target angle, nut retention, three cycles, and clearance.
comparison.reason: Measurement-driven conditional dosing does not overlap mechanical adjustment retention.
